about: The area config for one study round over the ladder (#8005 slice 5; docs/IA.md §5.5: the rungs a member earns by trading, the courses and checks, onboarding and the human playbook chapter — the Profile page's Milestones section, with the rung's strip, chip and link on Trade). Read by scripts/study/round.mjs; everything area-specific lives here or in scripts/study/worlds/ladder-*. Worlds, all on bot-loop-today's league (the pin's Monday, the pin as corpus): ladder-today (the owner and the friend have each bought stock, rung 101; a third member owns nothing, so onboarding has not begun), ladder-first-sale (the owner's first stock sale this morning earned rung 102 and opened the course of the wheel's option legs) and ladder-first-day (an account linked this morning, nothing traded; the next step is a hello to Moneypenny, which a world cannot yet let open the ladder, #8070). Phone first: 7 of the 10 frames are phones. Members start where the app nav's Profile link lands; the ladder is a section of it. Census routes are links the ladder builds (a rung's way to Trade, Trade's way back to the chapter), never composed. `roles` is who each member is here, in plain words, read by the experts and the words pass instead of the cards (#5099), so it never quotes a card. No sealed key, framer or tasks yet: those come when the cross-feature round clears (#8005).

roles.eric: Runs the league; trades his own paper account by hand beside his bot, and wants to know what he has learned so far and what to try next. On a phone when away, at a desk at home.
roles.returning-trader: Has one paper account and some options vocabulary, is back after some weeks away, and sold some stock this morning; wants to know what that trade counted for and what comes next. Uses a phone and a desk.
roles.phone-only: Uses the app only on a phone, one-handed, a minute or two at a time.
roles.invited-friend: A friend the owner invited, with one small account of their own and a bot they took over; wants to know how far they have come and what to learn next. On a phone.
roles.first-timer: Invited last week; new to trading and to the app, and wants to know how to get started and what comes after. On a phone or a laptop.

pages: a member's own milestones: chapters for getting started, for learning to trade one kind of order at a time, and for proving a strategy by hand, each with its progress and points
the trading ladder: courses from buying stock to options strategies, each rung earned by a real paper trade and dated
getting started: linking a paper account, saying hello to the assistant, and a first trade
the ladder as the trade page shows it: which rungs are earned, the one this order would earn, and a way to the full ladder
where these pages send the member next: the trade page opened on the next rung's kind of order, and back
